title: Level 1: Barren Wasteland

fantasyTransformation: A towering World Tree blossoms, emitting glowing golden pollen and floating islands.

Drag sapling seeds from your tool pouch into prepared holes.
Press space or click 'Nurture' to firm the roots before time expires.

Revive all 8 garden beds before the heatwave drains your water gauge!
